title: START-UP DIASPORA NEXT GEN

who: SAINT International runs the "START-UP DIASPORA NEXT GEN" program, offering non‑repayable grants of up to 200,000 lei to Romanian diaspora entrepreneurs who want to start or grow a business in Romania (eligible expenses include workspace, equipment, software, etc.).
fit_reason: The page describes a funding scheme for diaspora‑owned startups, not a construction‑monitoring service. While it targets the Romanian diaspora, there is no indication that the audience is actively building, renovating, or planning a house in Romania, which is the core ICP for Ochi pe Șantier.
hooks: Mention that the program supports diaspora entrepreneurs who may also be investing in property back home and could benefit from remote site monitoring.
Highlight how Ochi pe Șantier can complement a new business venture by ensuring any construction projects (e.g., office, factory) progress on schedule.
